---
name: "SVG net: a filter network Chrome computes"
about: Compute a tiny neural net drawn as SVG filters on your text and update the profile animation
title: "svg: example text"
---

This will continue your text with a **tiny neural net drawn as SVG filters**, every character computed by Chrome's filter engine, and update the animation at the top of the profile with the result.

Replace `example text` in the title above with the start of a sentence (for example `hello w`). You can leave this box as is.
